title: Tiphuphu Leti Tlakukeke Ta Tintshava Leti Sukiweke Hi Moya
intro: Anakanya hi nhluvuko lowu humelelaka lowu nyikiweke matimba lama tlakukeke ni vutshila lebyi nga ringanisiwiki na nchumu byo aka. Leswi a wu tshama exikarhi ka tintshava letikulu leti govekeke, muganga lowu wu tlakuse swikombiso leswikulu leswi khumbeke xibakabaka. Hambi swi ri tano ku tikukumuxa ku dzime timitsu, naswona xirhambo xo tlhelela evugandzerini bya Allah ntsena xi hlangane ni ku kaneta. Leswi landzeleke swi tshama swi ri xilemukiso lexi rhwariweke eka moya hi woxe.
clues: A hi ri tiko ra matimba leri teke endzhaku ka vanhu va Nuh, hi katekisiwa hi ku leha lokukulu ni matimba.
Hi ake swihondzo leswi tlakukeke ni switsundzuxo endhawini yin’wana ni yin’wana leyi tlakukeke leswaku hi ta tlanga ntsena ni ku tinyungubyisa.
Hi tinyungubyisa, hi ku i mani la nga ni matimba ku hi tlula hi matimba, naswona hi endle hi tihanyi handle ka tintswalo.
Hi arile murhumiwa wa hina Hud loko a hi vitana leswaku hi gandzela Allah ntsena, a n’wi vitana la tsaneke naswona i muhembi.
Hi hlekile xilemukiso lexi hi n’wi tlhontlha leswaku a hi tisela nxupulo lowu a wu xungetaka loko a vulavula ntiyiso.
Hi lovisiwile hi moya lowu karihaka, lowu nga riki na nchumu ku ringana vusiku bya nkombo ni masiku ya tsevu, hi sale hi wile ku fana ni swirhabyani leswi nga ni swirhabyani swa mirhi ya ncindzu.

verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
